title: Seam-card queues have no named reader: `repo:*` seat probes never scan objectstack's `repo:objectui`/`repo:cloud` labeled cards — a routed p0 sat unclaimed for a day and a half
body:
Filed by the skills seat (session `session_017TNzEetykdh7ceZGwuAPLq`, 2026-08-16) after the maintainer's direct question in the live PM session (verbatim, untranslated): 「这个问题报了很久没有处理，是因为 objectui 项目经理不会再看 objectstack 仓库是吗？」— the answer is yes, and by protocol design rather than negligence.

## Measured

- The Console filterBuilder p0 (`priority:p0` + `target:v17`, filed 2026-08-15 04:21) was triaged correctly within 29 minutes — settled seam placement, `repo:objectui` + `pm:queue`, dedup clean, fallback priced, p0 queue-jump noted. It then sat unclaimed ~36h.
- The `repo:objectui` seat post's 范围 section reads, in full: 「objectui 全仓队列」. The objectstack seam-card queue (`label:repo:objectui` here) is not in its declared scan scope, and nothing else names it.
- The pm-dispatch skill's seam-card rule (多仓协调 #1: seam cards stay in objectstack carrying `repo:objectui`/`repo:cloud`) presupposes the repo seat reads this queue — the triage comment on the p0 states that presupposition explicitly. Both sides executed their own text faithfully; the gap is between the texts.
- This violates the skill's own invariant: 「一个标签存在,当且仅当有具名读者」— `repo:objectui`/`repo:cloud` on objectstack cards currently have none.

## Deliverable (one PR, skills lane)

Give the seam queues a named reader, in the versioned protocol rather than seat-post prose: the `repo:*` seat's round-start probe (整车道一次读全) explicitly includes the objectstack seam query — `list_issues` on objectstack with the single label `repo:<repo>` (single-label per the OR-semantics trap row) — merged into the same candidate pool and priority ordering as the home-repo queue. Landing spot is the dev's call between the 多仓协调 rule in `SKILL.md` (one clause naming the reader) and `references/seat-post-protocol.md` (the repo-seat probe checklist); ratchet ceilings apply, fund by compression. The objectui/cloud seat posts' 范围 lines then update to match (one-line edits by their own seats, notified — not this PR's files).

## Interim mitigation (already executed)

Cross-seat notice posted on the `repo:objectui` seat post naming the p0 and asking this shift to include the seam query until the protocol lands.

## Constraints

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` ⇒ fable-mandatory (derive via `--tier`); ADR-class human merge; new text in Chinese, machine literals English; no issue numbers in operational text.
